instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium shot at eye-level. Outdoors on a wooden deck with a metal railing, backed by a river and lush green trees under bright sunlight. On the left, the woman in the pink cardigan and grey hijab (R1) stands in profile facing right, smiling as she raises her hands. In the center-right background, the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) stands in profile facing left, smiling and raising his hands. In the right foreground, the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) faces left with a smile, her hands raised in motion. The woman in the pink cardigan (R1) and the man in the orange t-shirt (R2) connect their raised hands in a high-five, while the woman in the beige hoodie (R4) prepares to join. Warm, natural sunlight illuminates the scene, casting a soft glow.
